models.name: Muse Ember
models.notes: League 1; calibration definition pending Ümit; late entry: its own decisions in late-entry matches against League 1's field (different positions from the league's); scored against League 1's Random; provisional: played 17 of 19 matches; not played: GPT-6 Luna (Decisions API) (opponent's API out of credit); not played: Inception Mercury Decide (opponent no longer served on OpenRouter); Meta's Muse Ember through OpenRouter, pinned to Meta (fallbacks off) for every decision; never on our GPUs. Late entry to the original League 1 table (not in standings, not eligible for the Hype Cup); its matches were played on 10–11 Nov 2026. It played 17 of its 19 opponents: its pair with Mercury Decide was not played (Mercury Decide is no longer served on OpenRouter; match #932 stopped before any decision, unbilled) and its pair with GPT-6 Luna was not played (GPT-6 Luna's API was out of credit). Every request sent reasoning_effort "max"; 21.76 M of its 22.09 M output tokens were reasoning. The endpoint returned no token probabilities, so it answers with one letter, read from the reply; 46 of its 1,713 answers named no option and a random legal play was made. Each decision is billed at Meta's list price from the tokens OpenRouter reported.; hosted (API or subscription)

models.name: KnowLine-31B-Gen1.5
models.notes: League 1; calibration definition pending Ümit; late entry: its own decisions in late-entry matches against League 1's field (different positions from the league's); scored against League 1's Random; provisional: played 17 of 19 matches; not played: GPT-6 Luna (Decisions API) (opponent's API out of credit); not played: Inception Mercury Decide (opponent no longer served on OpenRouter); Late entry to the original League 1 table (not in standings, not eligible for the Hype Cup); its matches were played on 10–11 Nov 2026. It played 17 of its 19 opponents: its pair with Mercury Decide was not played (Mercury Decide is no longer served on OpenRouter) and its pair with GPT-6 Luna was not played (GPT-6 Luna's API was out of credit). Each option's probability is a softmax over the option labels, stored as returned. Its first run played 4 matches at once (#933–936) on a server meant for one request at a time; those matches were voided (rows kept, left out of every number) and the pairs replayed from the start, one match at a time.; run on our GPUs

models.name: REAX 1.3
models.notes: League 1; calibration definition pending Ümit; late entry: its own decisions in late-entry matches against League 1's field (different positions from the league's); scored against League 1's Random; provisional: played 18 of 19 matches; not played: GPT-6 Luna (Decisions API) (opponent's API out of credit); Late entry to the original League 1 table (not in standings, not eligible for the Hype Cup); its matches were played on 7 Nov 2026. Each option's probability is the 50/50 mean of the two parts' probabilities, stored as returned; in the smoke test before the run every probability sum was 1.000000. Its pair with GPT-6 Luna was not played: GPT-6 Luna's API was out of credit. Run note: the server's container ran without Docker's no-new-privileges setting, approved for this run only (the host's Docker refused every container with it); every other protection was kept: all capabilities dropped, read-only root filesystem, non-root user, weights mounted read-only, no outside network.; run on our GPUs
